# Purpose
This generated header defines a seccomp BPF policy for the `watch` command and limits the process to a small set of system calls. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_watch`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_watch>) function builds a 24-instruction filter that checks the runtime architecture, then allows only `write`, `fsync`, `read`, `nanosleep`, `sched_yield`, and `exit_group` under fixed argument rules. The `write` and `fsync` calls are allowed only for the expected file descriptors, and `read` is allowed only for `drain_output_fd` or standard input. Any other system call, or any call that does not match the required arguments, ends with `SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS`, which enforces process isolation at runtime.
